647-2105-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
647-2105-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-2105-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1084-4279-4699.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-4699.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-4699.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

4336-5006-8170-8250.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
4336-5006-8170-8250.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat.

1981-3641-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-3641-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

647-2023-4289-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a brain counter on it
with a brain counter on it

1247-5536-7908.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Halflings.
1247-5536-7908.description:
Activate Rex using The Notary Hobbits' ability by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6289-7864.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4284-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4284-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4284-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1619-2034-4605-5542-6153.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6153.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Vicious Battlerager from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Vicious Battlerager token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Vicious Battlerager trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6153.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3532-5078-7729.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7729.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1367-7334-7417.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
1367-7334-7417.description:
If Nexus of Fate is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Blink Sanar using The Neutrinos. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
1367-7334-7417.notes: If Nexus of Fate is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

2082-3490-3967-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2082-3490-3967-7426.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat

757-3094-4644.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

2239-3617-5144.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and exiling Ephemerate.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

891-2843-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

457-1329-3338-5645-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Stenn.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1636-5397-6786-7028.description:
Activate Arcade Gannon by tapping it, causing you to loot. The discarded card will be put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirits enter, Intruder Alarm triggers twice, untapping all creatures twice.
Repeat.

339-677-5223-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3259-5734-6791.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
3259-5734-6791.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

643-3951-5703-6645.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr or Gogo.
643-3951-5703-6645.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Gogo triggers, causing it to become a copy of Altaïr with its name not changing, and causing both Gogo and Altaïr to get +2/+0 and haste until end of turn.
Declare Gogo and Altaïr as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the Godo trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

2506-2511-2721.description:
Cast Bloodline Necromancer by paying {4}{B}.
When Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bloodline Necromancer trigger, returning a Vampire or Wizard creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodline Necromancer.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodline Necromancer with haste.
When the token Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Bloodline Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3152-3542-5922.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
Helga does not have summoning sickness and has power 7 or greater.
3152-3542-5922.description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to its power that can only be spent to cast creature spells with mana value 4 or greater or with {X} in their mana cost.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Helga and Chakram Retriever trigger.
Resolve the Helga trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life, and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
Resolve the Chakram Retriever trigger, untapping Helga.
Resolve the Palinchron spell.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

277-1170-2499-2733-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

622-1636-5996.easyPrerequisites: Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
622-1636-5996.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
622-1636-5996.description:
Activate Kamahl by paying {1}{G}, causing the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-4153-5902.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
A creature you control besides Crystalline Crawler has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
2060-4153-5902.description:
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing at least five +1/+1 counters from a creature you control and putting at least ten +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing five +1/+1 counters from Crystalline Crawler and putting ten +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing ten +1/+1 counters from that creature and putting twenty +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability ten times by removing ten +1/+1 counters, adding {8}{W}{W}.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability any number of times.
2060-4153-5902.notes: Note that the starting mana can come from activating Crystalline Crawler's mana ability. Starting mana is reduced if the creature starts with more than five +1/+1 counters on it.

108-4013-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
108-4013-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-5220-5256-5615.notablePrerequisites:
The Master does not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken creature with power 1 or greater.
1636-5220-5256-5615.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill the creature from your library.
Activate The Master by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

403-2092-3371.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 3 or greater.
403-2092-3371.description:
Activate Codie by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Thassa's Ire by paying {3}{U}, untapping Codie.
Repeat as desired, skipping step 2 on the final iteration.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, cast any spell by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

678-944-1872.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When Composite Golem dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Composite Golem to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Composite Golem by paying {4}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Rona, Herald of Invasion // Rona, Tolarian Obliterator

1458-1547-4009.notablePrerequisites:
Rona does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three artifacts.
1458-1547-4009.description:
Activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting Rona.
Activate Rona by tapping it, returning Mox Opal from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Mox Opal by paying {0}.
Rona triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 3.

2776-3525-4241.description:
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, doubling your unspent mana.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Doubling Cube to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, enchanting Doubling Cube.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Doubling Cube.
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, doubling your unspent mana.
Repeat from step 4.

339-435-747-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Jegantha and Go-Shintai do not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken Shrine.
339-435-747-1636.description:
Activate Auratog by sacrificing another nontoken Shrine, giving Auratog +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Go-Shintai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning any Shrine from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The Shrine enters the battlefield, triggering Go-Shintai, creating a 1/1 Shrine enchantment creature token.
The Shrine token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1702-2575-3212.description:
Activate Jace's zero loyalty ability, putting Temporal Mastery on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Temporal Mastery, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.
